method: Fresh-context read-only source/key/report/verdict verification, including reviewer-accessible frozen skill references; no new model call.
correction: source_authority_valid false to true; raw grader incorrectly treated supplied skill references as nonexistent.

cases.report_quote: Tenant check on both read and cancel.
cases.reason: The report says DELETE goes through store.owned (api.py:11). It does not claim cancel authorization is missing. F1 is only about the worker effect.

cases.report_quote: The worker is external, and `README.md:3` puts the cancellation effect out of scope.
cases.reason: Worker effectiveness is treated as conditional and needs_evidence, owned by the worker team. It is not asserted as a failure or a pass.

cases.report_quote: This component is not shown to use either.
cases.reason: The TS redirect advisory is marked not applicable because there is no SDK or manifest and the README says there is no TS SDK or OAuth client. The checked version ranges are cited.
GET (api.py:8) and DELETE (api.py:11) are both shown to use owned. No poll tenant bypass is invented.

cases.report_quote: Assessed: tenant from identity, handle entropy OK, no size cap
cases.reason: The report assesses how POST binds the job to identity.tenant rather than the body. It cites api.py:4-5 and store.py:11-14 and checks handle entropy and size.
GET is traced through store.owned to job.result (api.py:7-9, store.py:15-18). The report also covers the unknown-handle and wrong-tenant error paths.
DELETE is traced through the shared owned helper and sets cancelled=True at api.py:10-13. The worker effect is kept separate as external.

additional_supported_gaps: F1: cancel only sets a flag that nothing reads (api.py:10-13). Impact is conditional on the external worker.
F2: store.jobs is unbounded, with no quota, TTL or size cap (store.py:10-14). Impact is conditional on ingress limits.
F3: an unknown handle raises KeyError and a foreign handle raises Forbidden (store.py:16-17). The two could be distinguishable depending on host error mapping.
F4: the tenant value is not validated, so a falsy tenant from the host could share jobs. This depends on an unknown external control.
F5: the component emits no audit events.
adjudicated_verdict.notes: Fresh-context adjudication: original grader could not see skill references supplied to the reviewer. Frozen control-map.md supplies OWASP/Tasks links and the dated baseline; advisories.md supplies GHSA-f897-62hf-6gxq and 2026-10-15. Report uses the advisory for a resource-limit pattern, not a claim of applicability. All other raw verdict fields retained.

scope_limit: Targeted reporting-failure audit, not exhaustive independent claim validation.
